A '''Watcher''' was a rank in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Watchers were observers that recovered, processed and analyzed data, then relayed their findings back to the [[Cipher Agent]]s. Watchers reported directly to [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]].

Watchers could be promoted from [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minders]].
